translations.text: Let us cut their bonds and remove their yoke from us.
I have established my king on Zion, my holy mountain.
I called aloud to the Lord, and he answered me from his holy mountain.
Human beings, how long will you conceal my honor, love emptiness, and seek falsehood forever?
Listen to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for it is to you that I pray.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your fury.
My eye aches from anger and is troubled because of all my enemies.
Lord, our Lord, how glorious is your name throughout the earth! You have placed your glory above the heavens.
All who know your name will trust in you, because you do not abandon those who seek you, Lord.
Have mercy on me, Lord, and see the oppression I suffer from those who hate me, you who lift me up from the gates of death.
In the wicked person's arrogance, the poor person burns. Let them be caught in the scheme they devised.
To give justice to the orphan and the afflicted, so that he may no longer destroy human beings from the earth.
I have trusted in the Lord. How can you say to my soul, "Flee and settle on the mountains like a bird"?
They said, "We will make our tongue mighty. Our lips are our own. Who is our master?"
Look and answer me, Lord my God, and give light to my eyes so that I do not sleep in death.
Who will bring salvation to Israel from Zion? When the Lord brings back his people's captives, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
The pains of others will quickly increase. I will not pour out their offerings of blood or mention their names with my lips.
I have set the Lord before me at all times, and he is at my right hand so that I will not be shaken.
You will show me your path of life, and I will be filled with the joy of your presence and with the sweetness of the victory of your right hand.
Rise, Lord, confront them and bring them to their knees. Rescue my soul from the wicked and from the sword.
He made my feet like those of a deer and set me on my heights.
They are more desirable than gold and precious stones, and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
These rely on chariots and those on horses, but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.
Your hand will find all your enemies, and your right hand will find those who hate you.
You are holy and dwell in your glory, Israel.
Lift up your heads, gates! Be lifted up, ancient gates, so that the King of glory may enter.
Examine me, Lord, and test me; try my innermost being and my heart.
When evildoers approached me to eat my flesh, my enemies and those who hated me stumbled and fell together.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and lead them forever.
The Lord turned back the flood; the Lord sits as King forever.
For there is rebuke in his anger and life in his favor. Weeping will stay for the evening, but joy will come in the morning.
God, by your favor you made my glory strong. You turned your face away, and I trembled.
Make your face shine upon your servant, and save me by your grace.
In my haste I said, “I have perished from your sight.” Yet you heard the sound of my plea when I called to you.
The Lord’s eyes are on the righteous, and his ears are ready to hear them.
The Lord will save the lives of his servants, and none who put their hope in him will be condemned.
Let them be like dust before the wind, and let the Lord’s angel pursue them.
Unjust witnesses rose up and questioned me about things I knew nothing about.
Your righteousness is like the mountains, God, and your judgments are like the great deep. You save humans and animals, Lord.
How abundant is your mercy, God! People take shelter in the shadow of your wings.
For they quickly dry up like grass and wither like green plants.
For I saw the wicked boasting and towering like trees in a forest.
For your arrows have lodged in me, and your hand has rested upon me.
For my sins have gone over my head; like a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
For evils beyond counting have surrounded me, and my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed me.
Let those who said of me, “Aha, aha!” be stunned by their repeated shame.
As my bones were breaking, my enemies taunted me. All day they said to me, “Where is your God?”
You are God, my King, who commanded Jacob’s deliverance.
You saved us from those who hated us and put our enemies to shame.
You sold your people for nothing and gained no profit from their sale.
Wake up and do not sleep, Lord; remember us and do not forget us.
Listen, my daughter, and look; incline your ear, and forget your people and your father's house.
He chose us as his inheritance and as the glory of Jacob, whom he loved.
Let Mount Zion rejoice, and let the daughters of Judah delight because of your judgments, Lord.

Like sheep they will be handed over to Sheol, and death will shepherd them. The upright will rule over them in the morning. Sheol will consume their form, and they will be driven away from their glories.
Listen, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
I will not take bulls from your house, nor goats from your flock.
Do good to Zion according to your pleasure, and build the walls of Jerusalem.
Day and night they go around its walls; injustice and deceit are within it.
I will give thanks to you among the peoples, God, and sing to your name among the nations.
Look, all of you speak injustice in the land, and your hands are entangled in injustice.
The wicked have been estranged from the womb; those who speak lies have gone astray from birth.
A person will say, “There is indeed fruit for the righteous; there is a God who will judge them on earth.”
Without any fault on my part, they ran against me and prepared themselves against me. Wake up and see!
The speech of their mouths is a sword on their lips, and they say, “Who hears?”
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is the protection of my head; Judah is my king.
Moab is the washbasin for my feet. Over Edom I will remove my sandals, and over Philistia I will shout.
Sing to the glory of his name; sing to the glory of his praise.
Come, listen, all you servants of God, and I will tell you what he has done for me.
The righteous will rejoice and grow strong before God, and they will rejoice in his delight.
The earth shook, and the heavens also dripped before God—this Mount Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
The princes went ahead, with the singers behind, among young women playing tambourines.
For they persecuted the one you struck, and added to the pain of the slain man.
Add guilt to their guilt, so that they may not enter into your righteousness.
God, give your judgment to the king, and your righteousness to the king's son.
May he live, and may gold from Sheba be given to him. May prayer be offered for him at all times, and may they bless him all day long.
For look, those far from you will perish, and you will destroy forever all who stray from you.
I have desired to draw near to God; it is good for me. Your name, LORD, is my confidence, so that I may recount all your wonders.
We give thanks to you, God; we give thanks to you. We call on your name and recount all your wonders.
For a cup is in the LORD's hand, full of a mixture of wine [?]. He pours it from this one to that one. [?] All the wicked of the earth will drain it and drink.
God, your way is holy, and no one is as great as our God.
The clouds dripped water; the highest heavens gave their voice. Your arrows also flew.
So that the next generation may know—the children who will be born and will rise to tell their children.
He split the sea and brought them across, and he made the waters stand like wineskins.
They loved him with their mouths, but with their tongues they lied to him.
They tested and provoked God Most High, and did not keep his decrees.
He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
Pour out your anger on the nations that do not know you, and on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.
Help me, God our Savior, for the glory of your name. Forgive me and deliver me from our sins for your name's sake.
You brought a vine out of Egypt; you destroyed nations and planted it.
So that we may not turn away from you, give me life, and we will call on your name.
Give justice to orphans and the unfortunate; vindicate the poor and the lowly.
Let them know that your name is the LORD; you alone are exalted over the whole earth.
I was counted among those who go down to the pit, and I became like a man who has no strength.
For he said that the world will be built by grace, and that you will establish your faithfulness in the heavens.
For you are the glory of our strength, and by your favor our horn will be raised.
Like the moon, it will be established forever, a faithful witness in the heavens.
In the morning it sprouts and grows anew, and in the evening it withers and dries up.
The days of our years amount to seventy years, and at most eighty years. Most of them are toil and pain, for humiliation has come upon us, and we have been shaken.
It is good to give thanks to the LORD and to sing praises to your name, Most High.
For judgment returned to the righteous, and all the upright in heart followed him.
Tell of his glory among the nations, and of his deeds among all peoples.
Let the fields flourish, and everything in them. Then let all the trees of the forest sing praise.
Lord our God, you answered them. You were an avenging God to them; repay them according to their deeds.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise. Give thanks to him and bless his name.
For the Lord has built Zion and appears in his glory.
They weakened my strength on earth, and in the brevity of my days.
But you remain as you are, and your years do not end.
The children of your servants will dwell in the land, and their descendants will be established before you.
The Lord is merciful and compassionate, slow to anger and abundant in kindness.
For he knows how we were formed; he remembers that we are dust.
For when the wind blows over it, it is gone, and its place is no longer known.
Bless the Lord, all his armies and his servants who do his will.
Bless the Lord, all his works throughout the whole earth under his rule. Bless the Lord, my soul.
He clothed himself in light like a garment; he stretched out the heavens like a tent curtain.
The deep covered it like a garment, and the waters stood above the mountains.
The lions roar for prey and seek their food from God.
May my praise be pleasing to him, and I will rejoice in the Lord.
The king sent and released him; he made him ruler over his people.
He gave them the lands of the nations, and they inherited the fruits of the peoples’ labor.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, and his kindness lasts forever.
Remember me, Lord, with the favor you show your people, and save me with your salvation.
They were jealous of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron, the Lord’s holy one.
They forgot God, who saved them, who did great things in Egypt.
For he broke the bronze gates and cut through the iron bars.
He blessed them, and they multiplied greatly; he did not diminish their livestock.
May they have no one to show them mercy, and may no one have mercy on their orphans.
For I am poor and miserable; my heart is troubled within me.
Great are the works of the Lord, and they are sought out by all who delight in them.
May those who make them become like them, along with all who trust in them.
Precious in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his righteous ones.
To you I will offer sacrifices of praise, and I will call on the name of the Lord.
It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in a human being.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the law of the Lord.
You commanded that your commandments be kept diligently.
The wicked sat and talked about me, but I meditated on your commandments.
Do not remove the word of truth from my mouth, for I have waited for your judgments.
I will lift my hands toward your commandments, which I love; I will meditate on them, on your commandments, and boast in your faithfulness.
Do good to your servant, Lord, as you have said.
You are good, Lord, and you do good; teach me your commandments.
Great is the wrongdoing of the proud, but I have kept your commandments with all my heart.
Their hearts have curdled like milk, but I have kept your law.
Your hands made me and formed me; teach me your law.
Let your mercies comfort me, as you have said to your servant.
Let my heart meditate on your commandments, so that I will not be ashamed.
They almost destroyed me on earth, but I did not abandon your commandments.
You are forever, Lord, and your word stands firm in heaven.
If your law had not been my meditation, I would have perished in my affliction.
My eyes wait for your salvation and for your righteous promise.
It is time to serve the Lord, and look, they have made your law void.
I called to you with all my heart, Lord; answer me, and I will keep your commandments.
Defend my cause and rescue me; give me life according to your word.
My lips will speak your praises when you teach me your commandments.
For the guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps.
For if the Lord had not stood by us when people rose against us—
They would have drowned us in the waters; a torrent swept over us.
Those who trust in the Lord on Mount Zion will not be shaken, but will remain forever.
For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the portion of the righteous, so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands to wrongdoing.
When the Lord brought back the captives of Zion, we were like those who rejoice.
Let Israel wait for the Lord, because mercy comes from him, and with him there is abundant redemption.
I will not enter the shelter of my house or climb onto the bedding of my bed.
I will clothe her priests with salvation and her righteous people with glory.
There I will make a horn rise for David and make a lamp shine for his anointed one.
Lift your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the Lord.
To him who made the heavens in his wisdom, for his mercy lasts forever.
Your friends are greatly honored by me, God, and their powers are very strong.
Hear my prayer, Lord, and listen to my plea; answer me according to your word and your righteousness.
In your grace, silence those who hate me and destroy the enemies of my life, because I am your servant.
Every day I will bless you and praise your name forever.
He gives food to the animals and to the young ravens that cry out.
The Lord takes no pleasure in the strength of a horse, nor does he take pleasure in the legs of a warrior.
Praise the Lord from the earth, sea monsters and all the depths.
Let them praise his name with tambourines and drums; let them sing to him with harps.
